definitions.short: enduring ; a species of hard-wood or lasting tree (perhaps oak )
definitions.full: H8410. tidhar תִּדְהָר noun [masculine] name of a tree , probably elm (Syriac (or PS) Lag BN 130 Löw 71 ; Arabic Lane 864 Dozy i. 432 (also ash , see Dozy ib .); so Symm & ᵑ9 Isa 41:19 ; compare Di, where also other views, e.g. plane-tree (Rabb Che), or pine ; — √dubious; Ges 41:19 Thes derives from דהר endure inferred from Arabic time , but this questionable; perhaps a loan-word), יַחְדָּו וּתְאַשּׁוּר תִּדְהָר בְּרוֺשׁ 41:19 = 60:13 .
